title: Northgate Card Cardholder Savings, Special Financing and Outside Rewards — Benefit Terms by Card
content:
The benefits a **Northgate Card Credit Accounts (issued by Harbor Point Bank, N.A.)** card carries at Northgate and elsewhere differ by card as follows.

| Card | Discount taken at checkout on eligible Northgate purchases paid with the card | Standard shipping on Ship to Home orders paid with the card free regardless of order size | Extra calendar days added to the standard return window for items bought with the card | Rewards on purchases outside Northgate, credited at statement close | Smallest single Northgate purchase eligible for special financing | Special financing periods offered at checkout |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Secured Card | 3% | no | 30 | not applicable | not applicable | none offered |
| Northgate Store Card | 5% | yes | 30 | not applicable | 299.00 USD | 6 or 12 months |
| Northgate Mastercard | 5% | yes | 30 | 1% | not applicable | none offered |
| Northgate World Mastercard | 5% | yes | 30 | 1.5% | not applicable | none offered |
| Northgate Business Store Card | 3% | no | 0 | not applicable | 499.00 USD | 6 months |
| Northgate Business Mastercard | 3% | no | 0 | 1% | not applicable | none offered |

**Purchase types on which the cardholder discount never applies (every card):** gift cards, prescriptions, membership fees, protection plans, and Northgate Marketplace items fulfilled by the seller (marketplace seller-fulfilled).

**Reading the table.**

- The discount is 5% on the Northgate Store Card, the Northgate Mastercard and the Northgate World Mastercard, and 3% on the Northgate Secured Card and both business cards.
- Outside rewards are earned only on the three Mastercard cards: 1% on the Northgate Mastercard and the Northgate Business Mastercard, and 1.5% on the Northgate World Mastercard. The closed-loop cards earn none.
- Special financing is offered only on the Northgate Store Card (6 or 12 months, on a single Northgate purchase of at least 299.00 USD) and the Northgate Business Store Card (6 months, on a single Northgate purchase of at least 499.00 USD).
- Hypothetical illustration of the return window: an item with a standard 30-day return window, bought with a Northgate Store Card, gets 30 extra days, 60 in all; bought with a Northgate Business Store Card it gets 0 extra days.
